title: Per-Deployment Connection Registry
description: ADR 0448 — describes how to reach the Proxmox host and its guest VMs for a given deployment. Lives at .local/deployments/<slug>/connection.yml (gitignored).

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on incompatible changes.

addr.description: Public address (IPv4 / IPv6 / hostname) of the Proxmox host.

port.description: SSH port on the Proxmox host.

user.description: Admin user on the Proxmox host (typically 'root' or 'ops').

oneOf.description: Path to the SSH key used to authenticate as <user>@<addr>. Relative paths resolve against the repo's .local/ssh/ directory.

vault.description: ADR 0469 — OpenBao secret path. Materialized to a tempfile (mode 0600) at use time and unlinked when the wrapper exits.

key.description: SSH key reference. Either a literal path or a {vault: <path>} form.

oneOf.description: Path to the SSH key used to authenticate as <user>@<guest>. Relative paths resolve against the repo's .local/ssh/ directory. Often distinct from proxmox_host.key (host root key vs guest ops key).

vault.description: ADR 0469 — OpenBao secret path. Materialized to a tempfile (mode 0600) at use time and unlinked when the wrapper exits.

key.description: SSH key reference. Either a literal path or a {vault: <path>} form.

jump_user.description: User on the Proxmox host used as the SSH ProxyCommand jump. Defaults to proxmox_host.user when absent.

jump_via.description: ProxyCommand routing mode. Currently only 'proxmox_host' is supported.

extras.description: Optional per-deployment extras (DNS API tokens, registrar credentials, etc.). Free-form to avoid schema churn for one-off bootstrap flows.
